name: Motorola Solutions
outlook:
What Motorola Solutions says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: revenue growth and non-GAAP EPSThe company expects revenue growth of approximately 13% compared to the fourth quarter of 2025 and non-GAAP EPS between $5.47 and $5.52 per share.
  • Full year 2026: revenue and non-GAAP EPSThe company now expects revenue of approximately $13.050 billion, up from its prior guidance of $12.975 billion and non-GAAP EPS between $17.94 and $17.99 per share, up from its prior guidance of between $17.62 and $17.72 per share.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 4, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
